mines.mine_notes: Underground gold mine (100%), southeast Ecuador. Single producing asset. FY2025: 503,330 oz sold; mill processed 1,828,225 tonnes at record 5,009 tpd; avg recovery 89.0%; cash operating costs $838/oz sold; AISC $1,015/oz sold at 72% AISC margin; average realized gold price $3,594/oz. Processing: conventional gravity-flotation-cyanidation (SAG-ball comminution, gravity circuit, rougher-cleaner flotation producing gold concentrate for sale, CIL on flotation tailings producing doré). Offtake agreement covers 50% of gold production up to 2.5 Moz. FDNS domain added to reserves in 2025; underground mine development to proceed. Mine-to-Mill Expansion Study to evaluate beyond 5,500 tpd by end of 2026; 133 km exploration drilling planned for 2026.

notes: FY2025 revenue $1.78B (gold sales net of treatment/refining charges); operating cash flow $1.0B; free cash flow $926M; net income $792M. Cash balance $630M at year-end after $664M of quarterly dividend payments; Q4 dividend $1.15/share (~$278M) payable March 26, 2026. Company has no other operating mines; extensive greenfield exploration land package (~50,000+ ha) excluded.
